class.name: IfcTopologicalRepresentationItem
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : The topological representation item is the supertype for all the topological representation items in the geometry resource. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: topological_representation_item. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-42:1994, p.129 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORY: New entity in IFC Release 1.5
